answer_1.quote: The assistant can highlight possible responses, which are expected to be accurate enough to greatly save CSRs' time by copying these responses...and explain these responses via clue chains.
datasets: Chinese e-commerce platform manuals (43,348 self-constructed Q&A pairs, 4,393 test QA pairs)
answer_1.outputs: Textual response clues (answers) to user questions, together with explanatory clue chains.

answer_2.quote: Besides the BLEU, Rouge-L, and BERTScore scores, we also care about whether it can save time with the help of CARE.

answer_4.quote: We further conduct a live test in the real-world scenario, where newly hired CSRs are trained with the help of reading assistants...We also report the average time spent for a CSR to answer all user questions...we calculate the ICC (Intraclass Correlation Coefficient) score for each group.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluation measured average time to answer, accuracy of the provided responses, and ICC score to assess inter-rater reliability.
